In the Belgrave 3kms Championships held at Battersea Park on September 2nd in conjunction with the MAFF meeting, John Hall was the winner with John Llewellin and Carl Lawton backing up. In the Civil Service 7 mile and 5 km Championships respectively at Blackheath, John Hall and Sue Porter were both winners.
Congratulations to Cliff Brooks and Doug Fotheringham who were elected Life Members at the recent AGM. And also to Sue Porter, Frank Ward and Keith Duckett, now Vice-Presidents.
